text:
lara: Quick ask for managers: building a 1-page microbank of paste-ready handoff lines and self-review scaffolds for midcycle. Keep examples short and utility-first.
mitra: add a one-line 'why it mattered' so calibrators get context.
theo: also include a coach prompt for 1:1s.
jen: sharing a compact set below; I'll tidy and add as a handbook snippet.
hr-bot: Reminder: self-review window opens Monday, calendar invites with calibration slots were sent.

```
Project evidence line (<=140 chars):
- Shipped [feature] to [users] enabling [action], leading to [top-level outcome].
KPI anchor (single-line):
- KPI: [metric] from [baseline] -> [current] (delta: [+X%/-Y%])
Risk & next step (single-line):
- Risk: [short cause] | Next: @OWNER will [action] by [date]

People/craft line:
- Coaching: ran [workshop] with [N] peers; observed [behavior change].
Why it mattered (<=120 chars):
- Why: reduced handoff time / boosted launch confidence / sped onboarding for [team].

Manager 1:1 coach prompt (single sentence):
- Ask: "What's one blocker you can remove this week, and what help do you need from me?"

Handoff tags (for trackers):
- tags: owner-assigned, docs-linked, dashboards-shared, onboarding-call, blockers-documented

Micro-handoff checklist (paste into issue):
- [ ] Owner: @NAME
- [ ] Evidence line + KPI added
- [ ] Runbook / design doc linked
- [ ] Dashboards / alert links shared
- [ ] 20m sync scheduled with new owner

Alt self-review (3 lines, each <=140 chars):
1) Outcome: [deliverable] -> [impact plain english]
2) Collaboration: partnered with [names/teams] -> [what improved]
3) Ask: [specific support needed: mentor / runway / prioritization]
```

mitra: nice. i'll surface this to managers tonight and collect 2-3 sanitized examples for the handbook.
lar a: perfect. jen, mind adding a formal and a conversational tone variant before publishing?
jen: sure, will add. will also attach this thread link in the review form.
lara: thanks all. last call for edits before i move to handbook. :sparkles:
